if(R36_BUILD_ALGORITHM_DEMO)
  add_library(perception_node STATIC
    src/perception_node.cpp src/node_input.cpp src/node_output.cpp
    src/node_process.cpp src/node_metrics.cpp src/image_messages.cpp)
  target_compile_features(perception_node PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(perception_node PUBLIC include)
  target_include_directories(perception_node PRIVATE
    "${R36_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/include")
  target_link_libraries(perception_node
    r36_core sdk_bridge camera_input offline_input stereo_provider cloud_output
    process_metrics Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
  if(R36_BUILD_RVIZ_STREAM)
    target_link_libraries(perception_node r36_rviz_sdk_output)
    target_compile_definitions(perception_node PUBLIC R36_ROS_WITH_RVIZ=1)
  endif()
  ament_target_dependencies(perception_node rclcpp sensor_msgs std_msgs nav_msgs)
  add_executable(demo src/main.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(demo perception_node)
  ament_target_dependencies(demo rclcpp sensor_msgs std_msgs)
  target_link_options(demo PRIVATE "-Wl,--no-undefined")
  foreach(directory IN LISTS PSDK_LINK_DEPENDENCY_DIRS)
    target_link_options(demo PRIVATE "-Wl,-rpath-link,${directory}")
  endforeach()
  install(TARGETS demo RUNTIME DESTINATION lib/perception_ros_so_demo)
endif()
add_executable(raw_camera src/raw_camera_node.cpp)
target_link_libraries(raw_camera camera_input ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
ament_target_dependencies(raw_camera rclcpp sensor_msgs std_msgs)
target_link_options(raw_camera PRIVATE "-Wl,--no-undefined")
if(R36_DEMO_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_DIRS)
  if(TARGET perception_node)
    target_include_directories(perception_node SYSTEM PRIVATE ${R36_DEMO_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  endif()
  target_include_directories(raw_camera SYSTEM PRIVATE ${R36_DEMO_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_DIRS})
endif()
install(TARGETS raw_camera RUNTIME DESTINATION lib/perception_ros_so_demo)
